newsitem.title: UK: IPE confident can resolve Nov gas oil problems.
newsitem.headline: IPE confident can resolve Nov gas oil problems.

text.p: The International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) said on Thursday it and the London Clearing House (LCH) were doing their utmost to resolve complications in the record high November gas oil delivery.

The IPE said in a statement it was confident the complications could be cleared up but added that in the event that there was proof that IPE rules had not been followed appropriate procedures for resolving such a situation would be followed.

"It is the intention of the IPE to ensure that delivery is completed in accordance with the contract rules and where there is clear proof that this has not happened the appropriate procedures for resolving such a situation will be followed," it said.
The IPE added that delivery was proceeding and gas oil was being supplied and taken.

The statement said: "As this process continues both the IPE and LCH are actively involved in resolving these difficulties on an ongoing basis. As part of the intensive work being undertaken, the IPE and LCH are doing their utmost to assist the parties involved to meet their obligations in a satisfactory manner."
The statement added: "The IPE is confident that these complications can and will be resolved."
